scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 http://localhost:5000/health && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n server,electron "npm run start -w server" "electron ."
